description: Two-sample seed set for deterministic Phase 1.5 framework validation. Labels are derived conservatively from existing documented manual review and are not independent ground truth.

threshold_simulations.rationale: Sensitivity check only: test whether lowering the blocking resolution boundary changes the landscape decision.
Sensitivity check only: test whether a stricter minimum tracked duration changes the vertical decision.

known_spectators_or_irrelevant_detection: Spectators are visible along both sidelines.
Raw person tracking includes background people.
samples.reviewer_notes: The Phase 1.4 report accepted suppression because the 368-pixel short edge is below the current blocking policy. This is a policy-baseline label, not an independently calibrated quality verdict.

artifacts.reuse_notes: Reuse preserved CPU YOLO/ByteTrack observations, Phase 1.3B candidates, and legacy source analytics. Do not rerun inference.

recording.notes: Low resolution is a current blocking condition. Camera stability and obstruction severity were not independently labeled.

player_candidates.notes: Existing visual review reports all four court-player appearances in the ranked list, but exact duplicate and spectator-promotion counts are not labeled.

tracking.notes: The detector produced 161 raw tracks and short player fragments across a 61.2-second recording. Frame-level continuity ground truth is unavailable.

insight.notes: Normal Match IQ suppression was accepted in the Phase 1.4 report. Interpretation wording was not independently reviewed.
